presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: four participants with long labels, a long question, long reason and response texts, two exhibits, long state labels and captions, two shared facts and long comparison labels.
presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: the two complete rooms (four participants each, a two-seat table) share one panel drawn once; at 1:1 the panel band holds four speakers, the signal, the paused question with its text, the exhibits, two card texts, the sequence caption, the shared facts, the changed fact, the guide row, the neutral note and the key, and with the near-maximum stress texts (two shared facts of 64 and 51 characters, a 110-character changed fact, a 68-character neutral note) it overflows even at 16.4 px. Tried before capping: every row/band (2-4 columns) and stacked/column arrangement, room scales 1-1.3, the table beside or below, the questioner lowered or not, and the 45 px stress floor. Rendered BEFORE (production/scratch/hearings-05/capmeasure.mjs, hold, 1080p): 16:9 19.8 px / people 61.9 px; 9:16 17.1 / 72.9; 1:1 16.4 / 51.9 with panel-overflow. AFTER the cap (one shared fact of 55 characters, changed fact of 63, neutral note of 44, guide label of 41; every other field unchanged): 16:9 19.8 / 67.4; 9:16 17.1 / 76.3; 1:1 16.4 / 48.8 (>= 45 px stress floor); no problems. Every capped field stays longer than its baseline (changed fact 30, neutral 25, guide 27; the baseline has no shared fact). Pre-cap preset: production/scratch/hearings-05/LAW-0299.presets.precap.json.
